variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.notes: Desktop must remain file:./dev.db. Vercel must use a pooled PostgreSQL URL.

variables.name: DIRECT_URL
variables.notes: Direct PostgreSQL URL used by migrations.

variables.name: GF_APP_URL
variables.notes: Audit 2026-08-03 : aucun consommateur présent dans ce dépôt ; autoGenerate/autoManage désactivés pour éviter un secret orphelin.

variables.name: NEXTAUTH_SECRET
variables.notes: Rotation invalidates sessions and may make d1-encrypted TOTP/SMTP data unreadable.

variables.name: GARAGEFLOW_API_KEY
variables.notes: Must be changed transactionally in Vercel, local configuration and keys/server_config.json.

variables.name: DEVICE_TOKEN_PEPPER
variables.notes: Rotation invalidates existing device tokens and HWID hashes.

variables.name: GF_PORTAL_SECRET
variables.notes: Rotation invalidates portal and quote-signature JWTs.

variables.name: GF_UPDATE_SIGNING_KEY
variables.notes: Documented but not consumed by this repository. Never configure automatically here.

variables.name: GF_TOTP_ENC_KEY
variables.notes: Existing gtotp1.k1 values require the same key. No automatic multi-key migration exists. — Audit 2026-08-03 : aucun consommateur présent dans ce dépôt ; autoGenerate/autoManage désactivés pour éviter un secret orphelin.

variables.name: GF_SMTP_CIPHER_KEY
variables.notes: Existing gsmtp1.k1 values require the same key. No automatic multi-key migration exists. — Audit 2026-08-03 : aucun consommateur présent dans ce dépôt ; autoGenerate/autoManage désactivés pour éviter un secret orphelin.

variables.name: GF_SIGNATURE_SECRET
variables.notes: Rotation changes the derived signature-sealing key.

variables.name: GF_BACKUP_KEY
variables.notes: Must decode to exactly 32 bytes. Rotation makes raw-key backups unreadable.

variables.name: GF_DB_MAC_SECRET
variables.notes: Electron derives this from the HWID. A server value protects LicenseKey records and must not be rotated blindly.

variables.name: GF_INTERNAL_EXPORT_KEY
variables.notes: Generated in memory by Electron for each process. Do not persist or send to Vercel.

variables.name: GF_PRIVATE_KEY
variables.notes: Base64-encoded PKCS#8 EC P-256 private PEM. Must match the public key embedded in Electron and src/lib/license/public-key.ts. Never rotate or generate automatically.

variables.name: GF_PHOTOS_DIR
variables.notes: Optional storage path; defaults depend on runtime.

variables.name: GF_BACKUP_DIR
variables.notes: Optional backup storage directory.

variables.name: GARAGEFLOW_LLM
variables.notes: Only documented in the provider stub; no network provider is actually implemented in this repository.

variables.name: GF_INTEGRITY_MODE
variables.notes: Controls Electron integrity behavior.

variables.name: GF_ANTIDEBUG
variables.notes: Enables anti-debug enforcement only with integrity enforcement.

variables.name: GF_ALLOW_DEBUG
variables.notes: Development override; must not be enabled in production builds.

variables.name: GF_APP_DATA
variables.notes: Optional override for the local restore utility.

variables.name: EINVOICING_ENABLED
variables.notes: Drapeau maitre de la facturation electronique. OFF par defaut. Jamais active automatiquement par le reset (autoManage=false).

variables.name: EINVOICING_PROVIDER_CATALOG_ENABLED
variables.notes: Affiche le catalogue des plateformes (lecture seule, aucun secret). Defaut true.

variables.name: EINVOICING_CONNECTIONS_ENABLED
variables.notes: Autorise la connexion des garages a leur plateforme. Sans effet si EINVOICING_ENABLED est OFF.

variables.name: EINVOICING_OUTGOING_ENABLED
variables.notes: Autorise l envoi electronique des factures. OFF par defaut. Sans effet si maitre OFF.

variables.name: EINVOICING_INCOMING_ENABLED
variables.notes: Autorise la reception des factures. OFF par defaut.

variables.name: EINVOICING_PAYMENT_REPORTING_ENABLED
variables.notes: Autorise le e-reporting de paiement. OFF par defaut.

variables.name: EINVOICING_SANDBOX_ONLY
variables.notes: Verrouille l environnement sur sandbox (defaut true) : aucune transmission reelle par megarde.

variables.name: EINVOICING_DEFAULT_ENVIRONMENT
variables.notes: sandbox ou production. Ignore (force sandbox) tant que EINVOICING_SANDBOX_ONLY est true.

variables.name: GF_EINVOICE_CREDENTIALS_KEY
variables.notes: Cle AES-256-GCM des identifiants de plateformes. NE JAMAIS roter automatiquement (rendrait les identifiants existants indechiffrables). Generee une seule fois si absente, PRESERVEE au reset (autoManage=false), rotation controlee via un processus dedie. Meme convention que GF_SMTP_CIPHER_KEY.

variables.name: GF_EINVOICE_CREDENTIALS_KEY_VERSION
variables.notes: Version de la cle de chiffrement des identifiants (defaut 1). Incrementee lors d une rotation controlee.
